report:
Findings: There is a mild knee effusion. There is complex tearing of the anterior horn, body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus with a fragment flipped posteromedially. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  There is mild thinning of the medial compartment articular cartilage. Normal lateral tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage.  
Conclusion: Complex tearing of the medial meniscus as described.

MRI LEFT KNEE:

INDICATION:    assess for meniscal tear   .

PRIOR IMAGING: Bilateral knee radiograph [Date].
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanisms are intact. Focal defect of the patellar midline cartilage with underlying osseous heterogenous T2 hyperintensity in keeping with advanced chondromalacia patella. The trochlear cartilage is intact.

Anterior cruciate ligament fibers are intact with mucoid degenerative changes.

Posterior cruciate, medial collateral and lateral collateral cellulitis, including the fibular lateral collateral ligament, iliotibial band, biceps femoris and popliteus tendons, are intact.

Medial meniscus posterior horn complex radial tear.  Articular cartilage of the medial femoral condyle is intact.

Lateral meniscus is intact. Articular cartilage of the lateral femoral condyle is intact.

Trace left knee suprapatellar joint effusion. No Baker's cyst.

Focal bone marrow signal abnormality of the patella, as previously described. The remainder of the bone marrow demonstrates normal signal. Soft tissues are normal.

INTERPRETATION: 
Medial menisci posterior horn complex radial tear.

Advanced chondromalacia patella of the patella with reactive bone marrow edema.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia estudio.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Ambos meniscos impresionan de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de
rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales sin alteraciones. Cartílago troclear sin
alteraciones. Signos de displasia troclear.
Úlceras condrales de espesor total del vértice y faceta lateral de la rótula con cambios óseos
secundarios.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura. Tendón
cuadricipital, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales.
Edema de las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
Impresión:
Signos de displasia troclear.
Condropatía lesiones grado 4 de la rótula.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal.
Signos sugerentes de fricción de la banda iliotibial, correlacionar con clínica

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Medial meniscus injury; 5 months of left knee pain, initially 
improved and now persistent for 2 months after fall down the stairs. Inner 
knee pain 
Comparison: Left knee radiographs [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated 
knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard 
non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow 
signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive 
osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Moderate, partially 
ruptured Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Peripheral vertical tear of the posterior horn extending 
to the body.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Areas of full-thickness cartilage 
loss along the medial facet and median ridge as well as central trochlea 
with underlying subchondral edema.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Complete tear of the midportion of the 
ACL.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Grade 2 sprain of the 
popliteofibular ligament. Periligamentous edema about the lateral 
collateral ligament with intact fibers.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal. Ganglion cyst of the popliteus 
tendon sheath.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No 
lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and 
trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) 
distance measuring 11 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not 
previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. 
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. Venous 
fluid-fluid level in the popliteal fossa. 

IMPRESSION:
1.  Complete tear of the ACL with moderate joint effusion.
2.  Peripheral vertical tear (RAMP lesion) of the posterior horn extending 
to the body of the medial meniscus.
3.  Grade 2 sprain of the popliteofibular ligament and grade 1 strain of the distal lateral collateral ligament. Correlate for posterolateral corner instability.

Findings:  There is a mild knee effusion. There is degenerate complex tearing of the posteromedial corner of the medial meniscus. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  The tibiofemoral articular cartilage is well preserved. Mild fissuring of the medial patellar facet articular cartilage is noted. Normal trochlear articular cartilage.  
Conclusion: Mild knee effusion. Complex tearing of the posteromedial corner of the medial meniscus.

Suženje zglobnog prostora FT zgloba, izraženije u medijalnom dijelu, uz šire zone koštanog
edema medijalnih zglobnih ploha femura i tibije koji se uvlači i u rubne koštane apozicije.
Subhondralno je vidljiva i sitna cistična pregradanja kosti.
Gotovo potpuna denudacija zglobnih ploha medijalnog kompartmenta FT zgloba.
Promjene odgovaraju uznapredovaloj OA sa hondromalacijskim promjenama 4. stupnja. Stanjenje
hrskavica lateralnog kompartmenta uz hondromalaciju 2. stupnja.
Umjereni izljev suprapatelarno.
Prednji križni ligament je povišenog signala u smislu miksoidne degeneracije, potencijalno sa
arealima parcijalne rupture starijeg datuma.
Stražnji križni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Medijalni menisk je izrazito promjenjenog i povišenog intenziteta signala korpusa i stražnjeg roga,
sa ekstruzijom pod MCL za 5 mm - degenerativna ruptura.
Lateralni menisk povišenog signala u smislu degeneracije.
Lateralni kolateralni ligament blaže povišenog intenziteta signala na proksimalnom hvatištu,
moguće uslijed distenzije. Medijalni kolateralni ligamenti normalnog signala. Oba se prate u
kontinuitetu.
Uredan intenzitet signala hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa i patelarnog ligamenta.
Uredna je kongruencija zglobnih tijela femoropatelarnog zgloba. Povišen intenzitet signala
patelarne hrskavice uz fisure te manji edem patele u smislu hondromalacije 4. stupnja. Opsežni rubni osteofiti.
Edem mekih tkiva prepatelarno i pretibijalno uz fibrozno promijenjenu prepatelarnu burzu. Edem
Hoffine masti.
Bisagasta septirana poplitealna cista dimenzija oko 2x1.5 cm.
Manja ganglion cista uz tetivu m. popliteusa.

Trouvailles:

Il y a un épanchement intra-articulaire modéré sans kyste poplité.

Il y a des changements dégénératifs modérés du compartiment interne avec amincissement modéré du cartilage à la partie centrale du condyle fémoral interne et du plafond tibial avec légers changements réactifs sous-chondraux. Il y a un léger amincissement du cartilage des compartiments externes et patello-fémoral. Il y a une légère subluxation latérale de la rotule. 

Il y a des changements dégénératifs intrasubstance impliquant le corps et la corne postérieure du ménisque interne. Il y a une déchirure radiale complète de la racine postérieure avec extrusion du ménisque. Le ménisque externe est sans particularité.

Autrement le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps femoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Conclusion:

1- Changements dégénératifs légers à modérés, plus proéminents impliquant le compartiment interne tels que détaillés ci-haut.

2- Changements dégénératifs intrasubstance du ménisque interne, avec déchirure radiale complète de la racine postérieure avec extrusion du ménisque.

3- Épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Moderate degenerative subchondral cystic changes are present at the trochlea, lateral greater than medial. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. Mild, diffuse synovial proliferation. No loose intra-articular bodies are seen. Small, ruptured Baker cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: There is a horizontal tear along the posterior horn extending to the root attachment. Mild extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Cartilage appears intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: There is tearing of the inner margin along the body and posterior horn. No extrusion.
Lateral compartment cartilage: There is full-thickness cartilage fissuring at the posterior aspect of the lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is mild to moderate cartilage thinning and fissuring at the patella diffusely. Severe cartilage loss is present at the trochlea diffusely with subchondral cystic changes.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild tendinosis.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:


1. Medial and lateral meniscal tear.

2. Tricompartmental chondrosis, most prominent at the trochlea.

3. Mild quadriceps tendinosis.

4. Moderate joint effusion with synovial proliferation. Small, ruptured Baker cyst.
